title: Lateral Thigh Gliding
summary: Long light passes over the soft tissues of the outer thigh.
goal: Gently include the lateral thigh in the sequence.
startingPosition: The leg is supported and relaxed.
instructions: Place the palm on the outer thigh.
warning: Do not massage with acute pain, recent injury, marked swelling, or inflammation. One-sided swelling, redness, warmth, or calf pain should be medically assessed before massage.
